records.title: Cabinet approves continuation of the National Social Assistance Programme for five years from 2026-27 to 2030-31
records.summary:
NSAP is the central government's scheme giving a small monthly pension to elderly, widowed and disabled people who have almost no other income. Extending it for five years keeps that safety net funded and, importantly, commits the money for half a decade rather than renewing it annually — which gives states and beneficiaries a predictable floor instead of a yearly question mark.

The Union Cabinet approved continuing the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) for another five years, from 2026-27 to 2030-31.
records.status: Government release. The archive holds a summary, not the full text.
records.note: This is a summary held by the archive, not the published release. Read the release at the source.

records.title: Commencement notification for the VB—G RAM G Act, 2025
records.summary: Notification under section 1(2) of the VB—G RAM G Act, 2025, appointing 1 July 2026 as the commencement date, and so the date the 2005 Act stands repealed.
records.status: Appoints 1 July 2026 as the date the Act comes into force in every State and Union Territory.
records.note: Two-page Gazette notification in Hindi and English as published on 11 May 2026. The Hindi text comes first; the English notification follows on the second page.

records.title: The Viksit Bharat—Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025
records.summary: Replaces MGNREGA with a statutory guarantee of 125 days of wage employment a year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
records.status: In force from 1 July 2026. Section 37 repealed the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005 on that date.
records.note: Full text as published in the Gazette of India on 21 December 2025, after assent on 20 December 2025. Holds section 37, which repeals the 2005 Act and saves action taken under it. The rules and the schemes under the Act sit separately.

records.issuer: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
records.title: India AI Governance Guidelines
records.summary: MeitY's guidelines for safe and trusted AI innovation, setting out governance principles and institutional roles.
records.status: Guidance. Not a binding instrument.
records.note: Guidance published by MeitY. It does not create statutory duties.

records.title: IndiaAI Mission (Union Cabinet approval)
records.summary: The Union Cabinet approved an allocation of over ₹10,300 crore for the IndiaAI Mission over five years.
records.status: Government release.
records.note: The archive holds the release text as pinned for the AI-policy readability study. Read the release at the source for the published page.

records.title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
records.summary: An Act to provide for the processing of digital personal data, recognising both the right of individuals to protect their personal data and the need to process it for lawful purposes.
records.status: In force. The DPDP Rules, 2025 were notified in November 2025.
records.note: Full text of the Act as published by MeitY. The archive pins the extracted text; the PDF remains the published copy.

records.title: Framework for Implementation of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G), 2022
records.summary: The implementation framework for rural housing: eligibility and selection, house design, funding shares, convergence and monitoring under PMAY-G.
records.status: Scheme framework. Not a statute.
records.note: The central PMAY-G framework, hosted by the Government of Odisha's Rural Housing portal. The issuing ministry is the Ministry of Rural Development.

records.title: Approach Document for India, Part 1: Responsible AI for All
records.summary: NITI Aayog's principles for responsible AI, written as an approach document rather than a rule.
records.status: Policy approach document. Not a binding instrument.
records.note: A policy document, not a statute or a rule. It creates no statutory duty.

records.title: The Code on Wages, 2019
records.summary: The Code consolidates four wage laws — payment of wages, minimum wages, payment of bonus, and equal remuneration — into one statute.
records.status: Enacted 8 August 2019. Rules and commencement notifications sit separately.
records.note: Full text of the Code as published by the Ministry of Labour and Employment. It does not include the rules or commencement notifications.

records.title: The Right to Information (Amendment) Act, 2019
records.summary: Replaces the fixed five-year term of Information Commissioners with a term prescribed by the Central Government, and moves their salaries into rules. The archive holds the principal Act this amends.
records.status: In force from 24 October 2019. Amends the Right to Information Act, 2005.
records.note: Full text as published in the Gazette of India on 1 August 2019, from the Central Information Commission copy. Section 2 amends section 13 of the 2005 Act, section 3 amends section 16 and section 4 amends section 27.

records.title: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence
records.summary: NITI Aayog's #AIForAll discussion paper: the first national AI agenda, with focus areas in healthcare, agriculture, education, smart cities and mobility, and the data and research capacity behind them.
records.status: Discussion paper. Not a binding instrument.
records.note: Full text of the discussion paper published by NITI Aayog in June 2018. It sets direction; it creates no statutory duty.

records.issuer: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
records.title: National Health Policy 2017
records.summary: The Centre's health policy: priorities, quantitative targets and financing direction, including universal health coverage and a stronger primary-care layer.
records.status: Policy. Not a binding instrument.
records.note: Full text of the policy as published by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. A policy document, not a statute or a rule.

records.title: The National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005
records.summary: Guaranteed at least one hundred days of unskilled manual work a year to a rural household, and an unemployment allowance where work was not provided within fifteen days.
records.status: Repealed by the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025, in force from 1 July 2026.
records.note: The Act as published in the Gazette of India on 7 September 2005, held by the MGNREGA programme office. The text was extracted from the Gazette scan, so the running heads and a few words carry OCR artefacts; the hash covers exactly this text. It is pinned here because the 2005 Act is repealed and its own pages no longer serve it.

records.title: The Right to Information Act, 2005
records.summary: The Act setting out the practical regime for citizens to access information held by public authorities, with the exemptions, timelines and appeal route.
records.status: In force, as amended; consolidated text as on 18 November 2025.
records.note: Consolidated text published by the Central Information Commission, including amendments to 2025. The archive pins the extracted text.

records.title: The Right to Information Act, 2005 (as modified up to 1 February 2011)
records.summary: The Act as it stood before the 2019 amendment: Information Commissioners still held office for a fixed term of five years, and their salaries sat in the statute.
records.status: Superseded by the text consolidated to 18 November 2025, which carries the 2019 and 2023 amendments.
records.note: Diglot edition published by the Central Information Commission, English text. The copy is a scan, so the extracted text carries OCR damage ("tbr" for "for", "—(/)" for "(1)"). It is held as it reads rather than silently corrected, and it is the text to compare against when asking what a later amendment changed. The Hindi title page is included as printed.

records.issuer: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
records.title: National Health Policy 2002
records.summary: The health policy between 1983 and 2017: it reviewed what the earlier goals had achieved and set targets for disease control, health financing and public spending.
records.status: Policy. Superseded by the National Health Policy 2017.
records.note: Full text of the policy as published. This copy is the one held by the National Health Systems Resource Centre, a body under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

records.title: The Information Technology Act, 2000
records.summary: The Act governing electronic records, digital signatures, cyber offences and the powers of the Controller and adjudicating officers.
records.status: In force, as amended.
records.note: Full text of the Act as published by MeitY, including the schedules. Later amendments are not consolidated here.

records.title: The Equal Remuneration Act, 1976
records.summary: Required equal remuneration for the same work or work of a similar nature, and barred discrimination against women in recruitment and in conditions of service.
records.status: Repealed by the Code on Wages, 2019.
records.note: A reproduction, not an official publication: no central or state government copy of this repealed Act is currently served, and the transcription records that the original publication document was unavailable. It is pinned here so a repealed guarantee does not become unreadable.

records.title: The Payment of Bonus Act, 1965
records.summary: Required establishments above the coverage threshold to pay an annual statutory bonus to employees, between a floor and a ceiling tied to wages.
records.status: Repealed by the Code on Wages, 2019.
records.note: Full text as published by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.

records.title: The Minimum Wages Act, 1948
records.summary: Empowered the central and state governments to fix minimum rates of wages in scheduled employments, with a procedure for revising them at intervals.
records.status: Repealed by the Code on Wages, 2019.
records.note: Full text as published by the Ministry of Labour and Employment on its Reportsamadhan portal.

records.title: The Payment of Wages Act, 1936
records.summary: Fixed when wages had to be paid, limited the deductions an employer could make, and gave an employed person a claims route before an authority appointed under the Act.
records.status: Repealed by the Code on Wages, 2019.
records.note: Full text of the central Act as printed by the Maharashtra Labour Department. The Ministry of Labour pages for the repealed wage laws no longer resolve to the Act text, so the archive holds this official state printing of the central statute.
